text: Lead Me in Your TruthOf David.א AlephTo You, O Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
ב BethO my God, in You I trust,Do not let me be ashamed;Do not let my enemies exult over me.
ג GimelIndeed, let none who hope in You be ashamed;Let those who deal treacherously without cause be ashamed.
ד DalethMake me know Your ways, O Yahweh;Teach me Your paths.ה He - ו Vav
Lead me in Your truth and teach me,For You are the God of my salvation;In You I hope all the day.
ז ZayinRemember, O Yahweh, Your compassion and Your lovingkindnesses,For they have been from of old.
ח HethDo not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions;According to Your lovingkindness remember me,For the sake of Your goodness, O Yahweh.
ט TethGood and upright is Yahweh;Therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
י YodhMay He lead the humble in justice,And may He teach the humble His way.
כ KaphAll the paths of Yahweh are lovingkindness and truthTo those who guard His covenant and His testimonies.
ל LamedhFor Your name’s sake, O Yahweh,Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
מ MemWho is the man who fears Yahweh?He will instruct him in the way he should choose.
נ NunHis soul will abide in goodness,And his seed will inherit the land.
ס SamekhThe secret of Yahweh is for those who fear Him,And He will make them know His covenant.
ע AyinMy eyes are continually toward Yahweh,For He will bring my feet out of the net.
פ PeTurn to me and be gracious to me,For I am alone and afflicted.
צ TsadheThe troubles of my heart are enlarged;Bring me out of my distresses.
ר ReshSee my affliction and my trouble,And forgive all my sins.
ר ReshSee my enemies, for they are many,And they hate me with violent hatred.
שׁ ShinKeep my soul and deliver me;Do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.
ת TavLet integrity and uprightness guard me,For I hope in You.
Redeem Israel, O God,Out of all his troubles.
